content: The American College of Pediatricians (ACPeds) is a professional medical organization in the United States composed of pediatricians and other healthcare professionals who hold socially conservative views. It was established in 2002 by Dr. Joseph Zanga as a response to the American Academy of Pediatrics' endorsement of LGBT parental rights. The organization advocates for several socially conservative positions, including the following: It opposes the adoption or parenting of children by homosexual individuals. It supports restricting children's access to television and other forms of media. It opposes legislative mandates for the administration of the HPV vaccine. It is against the legalization of marijuana. It opposes abortion in all forms. The group has been criticized by organizations such as PFLAG, which identifies the American College of Pediatricians as an anti-equality organization. PFLAG describes ACPeds as a small faction of medical professionals that diverges from the mainstream perspective of the American Academy of Pediatrics (AAP), which recognizes homosexuality as a natural variation of human diversity.
